title: Kansas Board of Regents recognizes ‘outstanding contributions’ of six KU employees
summary_en: The board’s program recognizes faculty and staff at Kansas universities for their contributions to teaching, student success, research, institutional excellence and Kansas communities.
title_cn: Kansas Board of Regents recognizes ‘outstanding contributions’ of six KU employees

title: KU Kudos: Faculty and staff achievements, September 2026
summary_en: It’s time to celebrate Jayhawk colleagues’ achievements: KU News Service accepted submissions and combed websites, social media and newsletters for recent external honors and awards for current faculty and staff at the Lawrence, Edwards and Medical Center campuses and affiliates.
